title: Return Pickup Missed Multiple Times
agent_context: Return pickup has failed multiple times and customer wants an immediate refund. Take ownership, escalate to logistics for priority reschedule (or offer drop-off), and explain refund timing tied to pickup scan/return initiation with a firm next update time.

raw_content.initial_message: This is the THIRD time pickup didn’t happen. Just refund me already.
raw_content.context: Return pickup has failed multiple times. Policy: apologize, acknowledge inconvenience, reschedule with priority/escalation to logistics, offer drop-off option if available, explain refund timeline once pickup is confirmed, and provide next update time.

learning_objectives: De-escalate when the customer feels disrespected
Fix broken process with ownership and concrete action
correct_sop_steps: Confirm return details and missed attempts
Escalate and reschedule with priority window
Explain refund timeline post pickup scan

sticky_notes: KEY: Show ownership for wasted time.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if pickup is prioritized and rescheduled with firm window + follow-up
